rec.name: Sidebar + Article Glossary Section with Embedded Product Card
rec.status: Built — launched (rebuilt as block-based after a metaobject attempt failed)

what.text: A long-form article / encyclopedia section ("CRO | Sidebar + Article") with a left sidebar and a main content column. The sidebar shows an anchor navigation (e.g. "Verstehen & Erkennen", "Von Ei bis Kolonie", "Anzeichen für einen Befall", "Natürlich gegen Ameisen vorgehen", with the active item underlined). Below the navigation sits a product card (image, title, price, "Schnellansicht" quick-view button). Each article block in the main column has an optional image, an uppercase heading and rich-text content. A block can instead show a "Recommended product" badge, a short bullet list and an inline horizontal product card. It was built for a pest-control glossary (Green Guardia) where tiles on the collection page link to these detailed pest articles.

why.text: Educational content builds expertise and trust at the moment a shopper is diagnosing a problem (e.g. which pest they have). A persistent sidebar nav makes long articles easy to scan and lowers bounce. The product card sits right next to the 'problem → solution' content, so the shopper meets the matching product (e.g. an ant repellent spray) when intent is highest. A quick-view button keeps them in the reading flow instead of sending them to the PDP.

how.text:
Build one section with repeatable blocks, where each block is one article chapter. Block fields: image, image size, badge text, aside navigation text (the label in the sidebar), heading (HTML
allowed) with a heading-size selector, rich-text content, and an optional product picker. Section settings: a product shown in the sidebar, content max-width, corner radius, padding, product-card options and mobile spacing. The sidebar nav is generated from the blocks' 'Aside Navigation Text'. Use blocks, NOT a metaobject: a metaobject's entries appear on every page that uses it, so content cannot be unique per page. Each page therefore needs its own blocks, added through the theme customizer. Shopify allows at most 50 blocks per section, so split very large glossaries across several sections or pages. The sidebar sticky behaviour and active-link highlighting are implied by the screenshots but not described in the ticket.

items:
Block: Heading (HTML
for line breaks) + Heading size (H5 shown)
Block: Content (rich text with bold, links, lists)
Main Article: content max-width toggle, Max-width (800px), Corner radius (0), Padding (40px)
Product card: Show vendor, Hide price, Show secondary image on hover, Show product rating (checkbox added so it can be disabled when no reviews exist), Product image size (Natural)
Mobile: Top space and Bottom space (px)

dependencies.text: Shopify OS 2.0 theme (Focal) with a custom section and block schema, plus a product-card snippet with quick view. The product rating display needs a reviews app and should stay off without one. No metafields or metaobjects are required in the final version. The earlier metaobject solution was deleted because it could not hold per-page content. The client's store theme is not connected to GitHub, so JSON template data and content cannot be restored after an overwrite. Recommend connecting the theme to Git and backing up before structural changes.
